segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Takes deposits from the general public and lends them mainly as real estate-secured mortgage loans in the New York City area.
segments.evidence: The Bank offers a variety of deposit accounts, including demand, savings, money markets and certificates of deposit accounts.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on the mortgage, construction and business loans the Bank originates.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank's business primarily consists of taking deposits from the general public and investing those deposits, together with funds generated from operations and borrowings, in mortgage loans, consisting of one-to-four family residential (both investor-owned and owner-occupied), multifamily residential, nonresidential properties and construction and land, and, to a lesser extent, in business and consumer loans.
